This computer

1

Connect to your library

The address and password from your library's setup (also under Settings in its web page).

2

Sign in to Granola

Sign in with your Granola account, the one you record lectures with.

3

How to send

4

Start sending

Study Stash keeps running in the background and starts when you log in. When a lecture finishes in Granola, it's sent to your library.
